Book One · test build An AZTMM game

Nobodyssey

Homer's Odyssey, in eight bits. You are Odysseus, with twelve ships and six hundred men, and you mean to bring every one of them home.

Book One

The whole of it, from the belly of the Horse to the giant's door. Saves are kept on this device: stop where you like and press Continue.

  1. ▶Book OnePlay

    Troy, Ismaros, the Lotus Shore and the Cyclops, with the sea between them. About ninety minutes, more if you talk to everyone.

One level on its own

For a quick go, or to try a stretch again. The chapter's talk and the sea are left out; each is a run, a leap and a held breath.

  1. IThe HorsePlay

    Ten years of war, and the whole fleet is hidden in the wood. Keep five men silent while Troy walks round the belly of the horse.

  2. IIIsmarosPlay

    You took the city. Now the sun is up and the Cicones are coming down from the hills. Get the men to the sea.

  3. IIILotus Shorefour partsPlay

    Sweet fruit, slow smiles, and men who stop asking about home. Walk them back to the ships, one way or another.

  4. IVThe Cyclops' CavePlay

    A hill, a shut door and a shepherd with one eye. Quiet feet, a stake and a name that is no name.

New: the camp in HD-2D

The first walkable piece of the new look. Lit, shadowed, and slow on old phones for now.

  1. ◆The HorsenightPlay

    Inside the belly with the best of the Greeks, in the dark, waiting for the signal. Keep the men quiet.

  2. ◆Troy at NightnightPlay

    The city is asleep and drunk. Lanterns walk the streets. Get through them to the house of Deiphobus.

  3. ◆The Camp at TroysunsetPlay

    Troy is burned, the captains are scattered, and the kings want everyone in the ring at sunset. Bring them in before the wine does.

  4. ◆TenedosdawnPlay

    One night out from Troy. Twelve ships on the sand, a rock with an altar on it, and a promise you have not made yet.

  5. ◆IsmarosafternoonPlay

    The town is taken. The men are feasting when they should be loading, and the Cicones are gathering inland.

  6. ◆The Lotus ShorenoonPlay

    Three men went inland to see who lived here. The sun has not moved since you landed, and nobody has come back.

  7. ◆Goat IslandafternoonPlay

    Wild goats and no people. Across the water, smoke, and the sound of sheep.

  8. ◆The Cyclops' CaveeveningPlay

    A big cave full of cheeses and lambs. The owner is not home yet.

  • KeyboardArrows run him. Space leaps. Z is his hand, X his voice, L his prayer to the gods. C pauses.
  • PhoneTurn it sideways. Your left thumb gets a stick, your right thumb A, B, X and Y. Sound starts at your first tap.
  • GamepadPlug one in and press any button. The stick runs, A is his hand, B his voice, X his leap, Y his prayer.
  • Back hereUse your browser's back button, or press the back gesture on a phone.

Going straight to a level from a link: #play #horse #ismaros #lotus #cyclops. Anything after an & goes to the level as its settings, for example #horse&mode=trial.
